# Kenya Fund Finder

> Kenya Fund Finder is an open-access market data platform for Kenya — unit trust (money market, fixed income, balanced, equity) yields, NSE stocks, FX rates, commodities, and curated market news. Public data is free; sign-in is only required for personalization (watchlists, mock portfolio, price alerts).

The site aggregates CMA-licensed unit trust yields, NSE stock quotes, CBK-referenced FX rates, and global commodity prices, and presents them in a high-density "Bloomberg-style" dark-mode interface. Yields are sourced from fund managers' published rates; a 15% withholding tax applies to interest income in Kenya.

## Pages

- [Overview](/overview): Market-wide dashboard — top yields, FX, commodities, and news at a glance.
- [Unit Trusts](/funds): All CMA-licensed unit trust funds with annual and daily yields.
- [NSE Stocks](/stocks): Nairobi Securities Exchange equities with price, day change, and history.
- [FX Rates](/rates): Kenya Shilling exchange rates against major currencies.
- [Commodities](/commodities): Global commodity prices in USD.
- [Markets Dashboard](/markets): Terminal-style mobile hub for FX and commodities.
- [Compare Funds](/compare): Side-by-side comparison of unit trust funds.
- [Investment Calculator](/calculator): Investment, currency, and KRA PAYE (2024/25) calculators.
- [News](/news): Curated Kenya market and fund news.
- [Learn](/learn): Educational content on Kenyan investing.
- [Investor Checklist](/checklist): Pre-investment due diligence checklist.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): Privacy practices.
- [Terms of Use](/terms): Terms and disclaimers.

## Optional

- [Price Alerts](/alerts): Personal price alerts (requires sign-in).
- [Mock Portfolio](/portfolio): Simulated portfolio tracking (requires sign-in).
- [Watchlist](/watchlist): Saved assets (requires sign-in).
